mapper.insert: insert into team_media( filename, relative_path, mime_type, file_size, uploader_id, team_id, related_type, related_id, status, reject_reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{filename}, #{relativePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{uploaderId}, #{teamId}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, NOW() )
mapper.select: select * from team_media where related_type = #{relatedType} and related_id = #{relatedId}
mapper.update: update team_media set status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = NOW() where id = #{id}
